title: Raleigh Fall Train Show (42nd annual)
venue: NC State Fairgrounds, Agri-Supply Exposition Center
description: Neuse River Valley Model RR Club show: 500+ vendor tables, 16 operating layouts G to Z scale. The fairgrounds calendar now lists the Agri-Supply Exposition Center (earlier listings said Jim Graham Building); confirm at nrvclub.net.

title: Porsche Cary Cars & Coffee
description: Monthly dealer-hosted Cars & Coffee (2nd Saturday) at the Cary Porsche store; Porsche-heavy but all marques welcome, so VW/Audi owners fit in. Dealer site says 9:30-11:30am, some listings say 8am; verify on the dealer page or Facebook.

title: Bentonville Battlefield Fall Festival
address: 5466 Harper House Rd, Four Oaks, NC 27524
description: Day trip: Historic trades demos, wagon rides, live music and food trucks at the Civil War battlefield. VisitNC says Nov 14 and Johnston County says Nov 7; confirm at (910) 594-0789.

title: Dixie Gun & Knife Show, Raleigh
venue: NC State Fairgrounds, Jim Graham Building
price: ~$9-10, 12 & under free, cash only (confirm with promoter)
description: Gun & knife show; dates and the Jim Graham Building are on the NC State Fair event calendar, hours (Sat 9-5, Sun 10-5) on a gun-show guide. Price listings conflict, so check with the promoter.

title: In Heavenly Peace: Bentonville Christmas Open House
address: 5466 Harper House Rd, Four Oaks, NC 27524
description: Day trip: Evening open house: candlelit Harper House, a soldiers' camp, period music, wagon rides. Canceled if it rains; call (910) 594-0789.

title: NCRVDA Raleigh Used RV Sale
venue: NC State Fairgrounds, Jim Graham Building
description: NC RV Dealers Association used-RV show & sale; dealers cut prices to clear inventory. Fairgrounds calendar gives Fri noon-7, Sat 10-7, Sun 10-4 but lists only Dec 11-12; NCRVDA lists Dec 11-13, so verify the Sunday before going.
